Title: Member Login and Password Recovery
Caption / Description: The login interface provides password and Google sign-in and a password-recovery entry point. The recovery page requests an email address without exposing whether a specific account exists. The screenshot should show the available actions and explanatory message, without revealing reset tokens or real email content.

Title: Hirer Home and Discovery
Caption / Description: The hirer home page presents available services and job-related actions. Search and filtering support discovery, while the create-job action opens the task-publication workflow. Listings created by the current member are excluded from discovery and remain available through the appropriate management pages.

Title: Job Publication and Administrative Review
Caption / Description: The publication form distinguishes required task information from optional supplementary notes. After submission, the post enters the applicable review stage. Show the submitted state and corresponding administrator review view to demonstrate the difference between creating a record and publishing an approved listing.

Title: Worker Applications and Hirer Selection
Caption / Description: The applicants page allows the hirer to inspect workers associated with the selected job and choose one applicant. The job record retains the selected worker. A permitted profile link allows inspection of profile information without implying unrestricted disclosure of contact or bank details.

Title: Worker Feed and Service Management
Caption / Description: The worker feed presents available work and a route to creating or managing service advertisements. Existing-work pages are separate from discovery. Service management shows the advertisement’s availability, capacity, and status so that the worker can distinguish an active advertisement from closed or expired work.

Title: Service Requests and Accepted Work
Caption / Description: The service-request detail presents the hirer’s request and the worker’s available response. Acceptance produces a linked job and moves the interaction into the shared execution workflow. Show the request and resulting job with anonymized identifiers to make the relationship visible.

Title: Stripe Test Checkout and Payment Return
Caption / Description: The checkout example uses Stripe test mode. On returning to JangDi, the application displays the payment state retrieved from the server and provides a route back to the related work. The figure must not imply that a return URL alone confirms payment or that the example demonstrates a live transfer.

Title: Completion Evidence and Confirmation
Caption / Description: The worker submits completion evidence for the assigned job. The hirer’s view presents the permitted evidence and confirmation action. The relevant screenshots should show the difference between evidence submitted, confirmation pending, and confirmed work, using test content and the corresponding stored states.

Title: Refund Request and Administrative Financial Review
Caption / Description: The refund form collects the applicable reason and supporting information and permits removal of selected evidence before submission. The administrative view distinguishes a pending request from an approved, rejected, or completed refund operation. The example should be labeled with the prototype payment mode.

Title: Profiles and Restricted Contact Information
Caption / Description: The profile view displays the member’s uploaded avatar and permitted identity or review information. Compare an unrelated viewer with an authorized job counterpart to demonstrate the intended contact-disclosure boundary. Mask actual email addresses, phone numbers, and bank information.

Title: Administrator Management Pages
Caption / Description: The administrator interface provides management areas for users, posts, finances, reports, and SOS records. The screenshot should show the administrative navigation and a representative record-management view. Profile access through the avatar should remain in the administrative layout.

Title: Tester Feedback and Administrative Review
Caption / Description: The member feedback page accepts a general comment, bug report, or suggestion. The administrator feedback page lists stored comments and supports read-state management. These comments are distinct from job-participant reviews and are not presented as a completed quantitative usability evaluation.
